technique_roles: light wash shadow and negative-space balance

positive_prompt: Sparse sumi-e ink lines with light wash shadows, selective ink density for volume, large paper-white breathing room, restrained diffusion; translate only the photographed subject through the reference's ink handling.
negative_prompt: Do not copy teapot, cups, tableware, calligraphy, seals, or composition. No invented background, no Starbucks logo, no text, no hand, no cloth, no decorative frame, no watermark.

edges.subject: ink line with light wash edge, occasional dry-brush break

finishing_notes: use reference only for ink line quality, wash control, and negative-space balance
keep diffusion restrained to 2-3 edge bleeds

mark_edge_quality: sparse ink lines with light wash shadows
controlled dry-brush breaks, not heavy outline
negative_space_rules: do not fill background with pattern
fill_tonal_rules: group values in ink wash from light to mid, no color
use density for volume, not shading
background_cleanliness: empty areas match shared paper master
no speckle field or backing patch
sample_style_contract_defaults.frame_border_policy: forbid generated frames, borders, crop edges, and plate seams
sample_style_contract_defaults.abstraction_level: selective ink simplification that preserves source identity and imports no reference subject
